description: This file contains internal Kotlin functions related to managing session keys within the ai.openclaw.app package. It includes utility functions to normalize, validate, and resolve agent IDs from session key strings, as well as to generate session key strings based on device ID and optional agent ID.

methods.name: normalizeMainKey
methods.description: Normalizes a raw session key string by trimming whitespace; defaults to returning 'main' if input is null or empty.

methods.name: isCanonicalMainSessionKey
methods.description: Checks whether a given session key string is considered a canonical main session key, specifically 'global' or starting with 'agent:'.

methods.name: resolveAgentIdFromMainSessionKey
methods.description: Extracts the agent ID from a session key string if it starts with 'agent:', otherwise returns null.

methods.name: buildNodeMainSessionKey
methods.description: Constructs a session key string using a device ID and an optional agent ID, defaulting to 'main' if agent ID is not provided or empty.
